conditions: MR 15 is required to equip the finished bow; whether the Market also gates the blueprint purchase at MR 15 is unverified — expect to wait if you are below it.

conditions: Everything but the Cryotic run tends to accumulate on its own from ordinary play; only that run is worth a dedicated trip.
bonuses: Resourceful/Loyal Retriever on a Kubrow or Kavat reportedly doubles Cryotic pickups too, since it registers as loot rather than a mission reward — worth having on the pet anyway for the Nano Spores.

conditions: Each ingredient weapon must be claimed out of the foundry before it counts, and is consumed on build — any Forma, Orokin Catalyst, Exilus Adapter or Focus Lens on it is destroyed. Rank it to 30 first; invest nothing else.
The three builds are strictly serial, 36 hours total; nothing here parallelizes.
